video_title: Most Interesting NBA Trades That Never Happened

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks chose Miami's package over a deal for Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: the Bucks making the decision to go with the package that Miami was offering
quotes.quote: One of the big sliding doors moments in addition to LeBron picking Philly, and only LeBron knows how close he was to picking elsewhere, is the Bucks making the decision to go with the package that Miami was offering, the younger players, as opposed to going with Jaylen Brown coming out of Boston. Basically sending Giannis to Miami instead of Boston, thereby launching a thousand discussions about Jaylen Brown and basically guaranteeing he was going to get traded, which he did.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Details of the famously rejected Chris Paul trade to Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Lakers were receiving Chris Paul, Hornets were receiving Lamar Odom, Kevin Martin, Luis Scola and Goran Dragic

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The all-time one in terms of offseason, in terms of sliding doors, was in 2011 with Chris Paul. I was later told by a long-time employee of the league office that he was with David Stern when he heard the trade that the Hornets agreed to to send Chris Paul to the Lakers. When he heard the details, which I don't even fully remember, Bobby, was Lamar Odom, Pau Gasol, right?

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Marks
text_blocks.text: I pulled it up. Lakers were receiving Chris Paul, Hornets were receiving Lamar Odom, Kevin Martin, Luis Scola and Goran Dragic plus a 2012 first-round pick and the Rockets would receive Pau Gasol.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: How the Carmelo Anthony trade to the Nets fell apart
quotes.excerpt: It got so contentious that basically Billy and Masai excused themselves from negotiations
quotes.quote: That thing started in September of 2010 and it went to February of 2011. It got so contentious that basically Billy and Masai excused themselves from negotiations and Pete D'Alessandro, who became Sacramento's GM and now is in Orlando, the two of us were the lead negotiators in the Carmelo trade. I negotiated that deal at AT&T Stadium, tailgating, getting ready to go to the Cotton Bowl in the parking lot, maybe a couple beers in me. I negotiated that deal in Austin, going to see University of Texas the next day. I negotiated that deal all over different parts of the country.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Bryant's 2007 trade request and the failed Pistons deal
quotes.excerpt: the story goes that after Kobe approved it, then when it came time to actually do it
quotes.quote: Kobe Bryant asked for the trade in 2007. He came on the Stephen A. Smith radio show at the time and said I played my last game as a Laker or something like that. There was actually the framework of a deal worked out, which would have, remember the Pistons at the time, they won the title over the Lakers in '04, then they went to Game 7 and lost to the Spurs in '05. They were looking at what else they could do. They made an offer and the story goes that after Kobe approved it, then when it came time to actually do it, Jerry Buss came over to talk to Kobe and he's like, I just can't do it.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The specific assets offered by the Pistons for Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: The offer was Rip Hamilton, Tayshaun Prince and picks.
quotes.quote: The offer was Rip Hamilton, Tayshaun Prince and picks.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Lakers' failed attempt to trade for Kevin Garnett
quotes.excerpt: it was Lamar Odom, Andrew Bynum and some draft picks with Garnett coming to the Lakers
quotes.quote: It was 4.3 million, Bobby. Can you imagine you're just sitting at your house in Utah and the phone rings? It was Lamar Odom, Andrew Bynum and some draft picks with Garnett coming to the Lakers. I question whether this actually could have possibly ever happened, but that was the story. It was Lamar Odom, Andrew Bynum and some draft picks with Garnett coming to the Lakers. Before Kevin McHale sends him to Boston, that was the deal. And he took the, he took the, Bobby, let me think about this now.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Bulls considered trading Scottie Pippen for Shawn Kemp
quotes.excerpt: there was discussion to trade Scottie Pippen for Shawn Kemp
quotes.quote: Do you remember that when Jordan retired the first time in 1994 or 1995, that there was discussion to trade Scottie Pippen for Shawn Kemp? There's everybody has their different version, I don't know, and Jordan later gave an interview where he was asked would he have come back to the Bulls if Pippen had been traded for Kemp, and he said probably not because I had such a great chemistry and relationship with Scottie.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' failure to go all-in for Donovan Mitchell
quotes.excerpt: the Cavaliers came in seemingly out of nowhere, but the Knicks weren't willing to go all in
quotes.quote: You remember the Donovan Mitchell trade saga? Like it was like, okay, what are the Knicks going to end up giving up to get this done? The Cavaliers came in seemingly out of nowhere, but the Knicks weren't willing to go all in. And it's just one of those sliding door moments. Like they had Jalen Brunson, Donovan Mitchell would have been the bigger name. I don't know if Brunson becomes the player that he is if he's paired with Donovan Mitchell from day one of his tenure with the Knicks.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jerry West threatened to resign to prevent trading Klay Thompson
quotes.excerpt: Jerry West, he threatened to resign as advisor of the Warriors if the Warriors had traded Klay Thompson
quotes.quote: Famously, if I'm not mistaken, Bobby, I don't know if you remember this, but Jerry West, who was an advisor, the late great Jerry West, he threatened to resign as advisor of the Warriors if the Warriors had traded Klay Thompson for Kevin Love in 2014. Now this was before the Warriors won their first championship. They were, you know, it wasn't, you know, they, the Splash Brothers were, it was a nickname but it wasn't really a, a, iconic duo yet. And supposedly, you know, Flip Saunders, the late Flip Saunders, wanted, that was the player he wanted was Klay Thompson, and Jerry West threatened to resign.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Bobby Marks thought the Nets were trading for the 2nd pick
quotes.excerpt: we thought we were trading for the number two pick in the draft
quotes.quote: We thought we were trading for the number two pick in the draft. Chicago had two and 14, I think that year. I'm not sure what who whose draft that was. It might have been the LaMarcus Aldridge draft. And so we, we thought we had a deal with them for we're going to get the second pick. We're going to give them, I think we were at seven and we're going to give them a future first. We're going to get the second pick in the draft. I'm like, oh, yeah, all right.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr's obsession with drafting Stephen Curry
quotes.excerpt: Steve Kerr was obsessed with Steph Curry
quotes.quote: The story goes, so Steve Kerr was obsessed with Steph Curry. Amin Elhassan, our former colleague at ESPN, talked about how when he was working in the Sixers or the Suns front office that like they were so obsessed, Kerr was so obsessed, he wanted to see like video clips of all these Davidson games because he, we know, and he, he, he, he like, he like knew, he like knew everybody on the Davidson roster. And, you know, Kerr would come into the office, hey, how did Curry do last night? Well, he had 32 points, six assists and two Johnsons, which was like the guy's last name who would always botch layups from Curry delivering the ball. I don't remember who he was.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar's trade request to the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar made a trade request and it stayed silent for a year
quotes.quote: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar made a trade request and it stayed silent for a year. I must have been the LA Times that told the blow-by-blow story of the night that Kareem asked for the trade. It's a, it's an all-time great story. He writes about the night where, um, the Bucks and met with Abdul-Jabbar and they had Beef Wellington, and they ate Beef Wellington, there was like a, Beef Wellington and then there was a wine course and then a cheese course and then it was all over.
